$comment: Adapter-observed knowledge only — never identity/install data, that now comes live from the official ACP registry (agentclientprotocol/registry, roster.ts merges it in). An entry with registryId links to that registry by id; 'local' entries (registry doesn't list them) carry their own launch command exactly like the pre-registry roster did. assets: rules/skills/commands locations relative to the workspace; null = not mapped, shown honestly, never guessed (v1 maps Claude Code and Augment). metaExtensions: observed _meta conventions. quirks: earned by observation only. knownBypassBridge: forces the fidelity label to 'acts outside' regardless of the capability matrix — defaults false, none observed yet.

metaExtensions: authenticate _meta['api-key']: string — key delivery for the gemini-api-key method (advertised on the declared method as _meta: {'api-key': {provider: 'google'}})
authenticate _meta['gateway']: {baseUrl?, headers?} — gateway config for the gateway method
quirks: authenticate with a method other than the persisted selectedType clears the cached credentials first (clearCachedCredentialFile) — trying a second method logs the first out even if the new one then fails

gemini-api-key/vertex-ai/gateway carry no key input over stable ACP: without the _meta payload the agent falls back to env (GEMINI_API_KEY; GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI + GOOGLE_API_KEY or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT/LOCATION) and fails with -32000 when unset
